description: Speed test: main skill (C2m) vs v1.3 skill with decision audit (E1) vs v1.3-h HEAD (V13), deck_detailed, one wave (docs/09-speed-c2-vs-e1-design.md)

generator.sampling_note: Claude Code exposes no temperature/top_p; Opus 5.5 rejects sampling parameters. Effort is fixed instead.

C2.name: Hire Your McK (full-deck mode)
C2.note: Exploratory arm added after the main results (METHODOLOGY.md §12). Same skill snapshot; the mode is named in the request.

E1.name: Hire Your McK v1.3 E1 (decision audit, full-deck mode)
E1.note: Development arm (METHODOLOGY.md §13). Same request as C2; the skill snapshot adds the decision audit (Step 2b) and nothing else. From the holdout on, loaded from env/plugin-E1: the skill as frozen for dev-e1 (commit f5b01a4) plus the 1.2.1 waterfall renderer fix, so that E2 and compile changes in plugin/ do not reach it.

E2.name: Hire Your McK v1.3 E2 (audit turned into a plan, full-deck mode)
E2.note: Development arm (METHODOLOGY.md §14). Same request as C2 and E1; the skill adds gap closing, base and stress case and decision gates to the E1 audit.

H1s.name: Hire Your McK compile mode (restyle) on B's finished deck
H1s.note: Development arm H1 (METHODOLOGY.md §15). Input: B's deck for the same case and replicate, extracted to text, plus the briefing pack.

H1r.name: Hire Your McK compile mode (restructure) on B's finished deck
H1r.note: Development arm H1 (METHODOLOGY.md §15). Input: B's deck for the same case and replicate, extracted to text, plus the briefing pack.

H2a.name: Hire Your McK compile mode (restyle) on B's deck for the same case (hybrid H)
H2a.note: Holdout (METHODOLOGY.md §16). Same request as H1s; the skill snapshot is plugin/ at the holdout freeze (compile rules with verified corrections). Runs after B; input: B's deck, extracted to text, plus the briefing pack.

C2m.name: Hire Your McK main 1.2.1 (full-deck mode)
C2m.note: Speed test. C2 request; skill = plugin/ on main (1.2.1, commit 032de9e).

V13.name: Hire Your McK v1.3-h HEAD (full-deck mode)
V13.note: Speed test. C2 request; skill = plugin/ on v1.3-h at commit 5f0b04a (1.3.0-dev: E1 + E2 + compile + post-holdout renderer warnings).

c1-market-entry.decision_question: Should Onsoo enter the US market in 2027, and if so, by which route?

c2-profitability.decision_maker: Harlow Fresh Markets' CEO, for the February 2027 board meeting
c2-profitability.decision_question: How should Harlow reverse its declining operating margin, and which actions should it take first?

c3-ai-assistant.decision_question: Should Brightwork launch Dispatch Copilot in Q2 2027, and if so, how should it be packaged and priced?

c4-pricing-churn.decision_maker: Palisade Docs' CEO and leadership team
c4-pricing-churn.decision_question: Should Palisade raise prices in 2027 while customer churn is rising, and if so, how?

c5-negative-entry.decision_question: Should Parcelbird launch its own quick-commerce grocery delivery service in 2027?

c6-make-buy.decision_question: Should Meridian Motion manufacture precision housings in-house in 2027, lease a flexible cell, or continue buying from an external supplier?

c7-m-and-a.decision_question: Should Atlas FieldOps buy the scheduling software company RouteSprout in 2027, and on what terms, rather than build or partner?

c8-distribution-network.decision_question: Should Northline Home close its East regional distribution center in 2027 or retain and optimize it?

c9-capacity-timing.decision_question: Should Pelican Packaging reserve a second molding-line installation slot now, build immediately, or buy temporary overflow capacity?

c10-portfolio-exit.decision_question: Should Vesper MedTech discontinue its low reported-margin sterile connector C and redeploy the team to connector D?

c11-oem-licensing.decision_question: Should Boreal Autonomy grant North American exclusivity to an OEM for its industrial robot navigation software in 2027?

speed.note: Timing only, no judges. All nine runs start together. Per-turn timeout 45 min, no infra retries (one-hour box).
